description: This Java class 'Live3DReport' visualizes live 3D data points in a UI, subscribing to messages to update a surface plot dynamically.

classes.name: Live3DReport
classes.description: A class that creates a 3D live data visualization panel, updating in response to messages and providing a control component.

methods.name: Live3DReport
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the 3D plot and subscribes to message updates for dynamic data visualization.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Parses a message string, extracts RPM, key, and value, and updates the 3D surface plot.

methods.name: getControl
methods.description: Returns the UI component that contains the control interface.
